title: SIP instalments debited twice

acceptableCauses.mechanism: Bank kaveri slowed down during the SIP batch; debit-worker's shortened confirmation timeout (3000 ms) made it resubmit debits without an idempotency key, and the bank later confirmed both.

partialCredit.reason: The bank slowdown is a contributing cause but not why debits were duplicated.

keyCounterevidence: The 09:15 IST release came after the debits (06:00-08:00 IST batch).
job-scheduler shows sip-debit-batch ran once today, unlike the past double-run incident.
notes: Slow bank: kaveri from 06:20 IST to 08:05 IST.
